title: Declared model projection
requirement: WHEN a K trace is compared with Quint, the adapter SHALL identify its common domain and rule-to-action projection.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Finite call-return comparison
scenarios.when: A pure arithmetic/list trace is compared with a bounded Quint instance.
scenarios.then: The report names numeric bounds, field maps, hidden steps, state representation differences and unmatched finance/wait behavior; trace agreement is not called refinement.
scenarios.independence: Expectations from the spec text, the tracked hand-derived F03 oracle (fixture-oracle-data-01) and the tracked public Clean inventory; the holdout re-derives the oracle trace itself and requires K-only, Quint-only and joint K+Quint mutants to be reported as mismatches.
